corpus.plan_phase4_note: PLAN's 'do not fabricate a 24-tile corpus from two motif scenes' barred passing fabrication off as the actual target. This corpus is 24 procedurally distinct synthetic scenes, is labeled synthetic everywhere, and claims no target qualification.

entry_and_defaults.chain: public API only: run_walls_aspect -> _calculate_svf(patch_option=2) -> run_utci_tiles(save_tmrt=True, all 24 tiles)
entry_and_defaults.options: PINNED SYMMETRIC PARALLEL SHAPE via the public runtime_options context: cpu_budget=24, workers=6, threads_per_worker=4, identical for both arms, recorded in every phase JSON; no env manipulation, no memory_budget_bytes override
entry_and_defaults.shape_rationale: the shipped serial default shape extrapolates to ~20 h for the A-side 24-tile run phase alone (warm 3.24 s x 936 pixel growth x 24 tiles), beyond the 21 h partition limit; the 6x4 shape follows the S10-30 P4a pool precedent (options-pinned, disclosed). Allocation sized from OBSERVED admission arithmetic, not estimates: main's simulation-phase reservation at 1024^2/153 patches is ~14.06 GB per tile (second demo submission 14056731 refused 6-way at a 48.62 GB base: 'the 6 largest reservations sum to 84,346,117,320 B'), so 6-way requires a ~180+ GB container; the demo runs in a dedicated 220G allocation (default budget view ~105 GB), unchanged execution shape
entry_and_defaults.admission: dedicated slurm allocation provides a clean cgroup view; S03b admission runs unmodified at the pinned shape; refusal would be recorded, not overridden

run_limits.timed_passes: exactly ONE timed pass per arm over the 24-tile manifest (walls, svf, run phases) after the untimed prime; total 6 measured phase walls + 1 crosscheck
run_limits.prime: untimed full-chain prime per arm on the isolated prime tile; excluded from all measured values (S10-30 methodology). Prime runs at SHIPPED SERIAL DEFAULTS: the first demo submission (slurm 14056137) showed that main (pre-S03b) refuses a 1-tile run planned at active_workers=6 ('requested 6 concurrent phase jobs but only 1 fit' — the admissible count is bounded by the 1-job queue), so the parallel shape is reserved for the 24-tile measured phases where both arms admit; recorded as an observed pre-S03b admission behavior difference, not worked around on main's side.
run_limits.retry: at most ONE causal retry per arm for an environmental crash (disclosed with cause if used); no re-arming for better numbers
run_limits.timed_only_by: perf_counter around the entry call; nothing else inside the timer

measurements.phase_walls: walls_aspect_s, svf_s, run_utci_tiles_s per arm (24-tile totals; serial shape means no per-tile timers inside the single public call)
